description: Check real-time Disney World resort hotel room availability, categories, and nightly rates across all 35 Disney resorts (e.g. Disney's Riviera Resort, Grand Floridian, Polynesian, Contemporary, Beach Club, Yacht Club, BoardWalk, Animal Kingdom Lodge, Caribbean Beach, Pop Century, Art of Animation).

checkInDate.description: Arrival date in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g., "2026-11-15"). Optional; defaults to 14 days out if omitted.

checkOutDate.description: Departure date in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g., "2026-11-19"). Optional; defaults to 4 nights after check-in if omitted.

resort.description: Optional Disney resort name or slug (e.g., "riviera", "grand floridian", "polynesian", "contemporary"). Omit to check all 35 resorts.

name: get_resort_hotel_availability
